What I do

One call covers the whole list

Most contractors skip small jobs or can't do custom woodworking. Charley does both, for projects of any size.

  • General home repairs

    Doors, trim, drywall patches, loose fixtures and the rest of the honey-do list.

  • Light electrical

    Ceiling fans, light fixtures, switches and outlets swapped and wired right.

  • Light plumbing

    Sinks, faucets, vanities and tub installs. Leaks found and fixed.

  • Custom woodworking

    Butcher-block countertops, mantels, built-in shelving and access doors made to fit.

  • Decks & porches

    Deck repairs, rail work and porch enclosures.

  • Painting

    Interior walls, trim and touch-ups after repairs.

  • Drywall

    Holes, cracks and new sections hung, taped and finished.

  • Remodel help

    Kitchen and bath updates, flooring transitions and finish carpentry.
